1. Magnetic Mount Detector: Many hidden vehicle GPS trackers use strong magnets. Your phone magnetometer measures magnetic flux in μT to spot hidden magnetic spikes (typically > 85 μT).

2. Bluetooth Tracker Scan: Scans nearby BLE advertisements to flag AirTag / Find My, Samsung SmartTag, Tile, and close-range wireless beacons.

3. Device GPS Check: Verifies whether GPS hardware is installed on your device and reads live GNSS satellite signal strength (dB-Hz).

Note: Passive cellular-only trackers with no magnet or Bluetooth radio cannot be directly detected by standard phone sensors.
